Adding a few additional people since we haven't gotten a response.

Order ···· was labeled with ACP carrier, but we understand you do not ship with ACP. We need your approval to refund the existing label and relabel this order with DHL or another carrier of your choice.

Please confirm which carrier you would like us to use for this order (DHL or specify an alternative).

Let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
ShipBob A. Agent
Handed to the team · Carrier choice and the label refund are a cost decision only Abel or Georges can

Hello,

Thanks for the follow-up, and sorry for the delay on our side.

I can see the shipment: ····, Dillon J., Overclocking Bundle, packed at Brampton (Ontario) for (address hidden). You are right that we do not ship with ACP.

The carrier choice and the label refund are not mine to approve, so I have passed this to Georges and Abel on our team and one of them is picking it up today with a confirmed carrier for this shipment. Please hold the relabel until you have that confirmation from them.

The order is already past its estimated fulfillment date, so if you can keep it prioritised once the new label is cut, we would appreciate it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Team,

Please accept my apologies for the delayed response. I have reviewed the order ···· and I have labelled it using UPS as we were not getting an option to ship it via DHL.

Please feel free to connect in case of any query.

Best Regards,

Jyoti A.
